outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the drawer handle in frames 0–77, then closes its gripper around the handle in frames 78–86 (wrist_image). Frames 94–120 show the drawer moving outward from the cabinet (image and left_ego_image). By frames 126–133, the drawer remains visibly open with its interior exposed, and the gripper has released the handle (image, left_ego_image, and wrist_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visibly established.
